quotes.text: For the Commands default port 4310, the user's stated preference is to close an existing Commands console automatically. The recorded safeguard first checks console identity and authentication, then uses its protected close endpoint and waits for release. An unrelated or unidentified listener requires a random fallback port. Focused tests passed; this is specific to the Commands console.
